info.name: TicketFlow
info.description:
# TicketFlow

TicketFlow is a REST API collection for managing a support ticketing system. It covers the full lifecycle of support operations — from authentication through ticket and technician management — and provides dashboard-level visibility into key metrics.

## Authentication

Handled via the **Connections** folder. Use the `Login` endpoint to obtain a bearer token (`POST /auth/login`), which is automatically applied to all requests via the collection-level bearer auth. Use `Logout` to invalidate the current session.

## Tickets

The **Tickets** folder exposes full CRUD operations on support tickets via `/tickets` and `/tickets/:id`. You can create, retrieve, update, and delete tickets individually or in bulk, and append notes to a specific ticket via `/tickets/:id/notes`.

## Technicians

The **Technicians** folder provides full CRUD operations on technician records via `/technicians` and `/technicians/:id`. Supports creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting both single and multiple entries.

## Dashboard

The **Dashboard** folder contains a `GetStats` endpoint (`GET /dashboard?type=...`) for retrieving aggregated statistics, with support for filtering by entity type (e.g. technicians).

item.name: Dashboard

request.description:
Retrieves aggregated statistics from the dashboard, scoped to a specific entity type. Use this endpoint to fetch summary metrics filtered by the provided `type` parameter (e.g., technicians).

## Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type   | Required | Description                                                                 | Example        |
|-----------|--------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------|
| `type`    | string | Yes      | Filters the dashboard statistics by entity type. Determines which category of aggregated data is returned. | `technicians` |

## Authentication

This endpoint requires a **Bearer token**. Include the token in the `Authorization` header using the `{{token}}` variable:

```
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
```

Ensure `{{token}}` is set in your active environment or collection variables before sending the request.

## Notes

- `{{baseUrl}}` must be defined in the active environment. It represents the base URL of the API (e.g., `https://api.example.com`).
- The full request URL resolves to: `{{baseUrl}}/dashboard?type=technicians`
- This request is part of the **Dashboard** folder within the **TicketFlow** collection.

item.name: Tickets

request.description:
## Get Many Tickets

Retrieves a paginated list of tickets. Supports filtering by status, keyword search, and sorting by various fields. All query parameters are optional — omitting them will return results using the server's default values.

---

## Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description | Required | Example Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` | number | The page number to retrieve (for pagination). | Optional | `1` |
| `limit` | number | Number of ticket results to return per page. | Optional | `5` |
| `status` | string | Filter tickets by their status. | Optional | `open` |
| `search` | string | Keyword to search and filter tickets by. | Optional | `imp` |
| `sortBy` | string | Field name to sort the results by. | Optional | `priority` |
| `orderBy` | string | Sort direction — `asc` for ascending, `desc` for descending. | Optional | `desc` |

---

## Notes

- All query parameters are **optional**. If omitted, the API will use its default pagination and ordering.
    
- The `page` and `limit` parameters work together to paginate results (e.g., `page=1&limit=5` returns the first 5 tickets).
    
- The `search` parameter performs a keyword match against ticket fields (e.g., `search=imp` matches tickets containing "imp").
    
- Valid values for `orderBy` are `asc` (ascending) and `desc` (descending).

## Get One Ticket

Retrieves the details of a single ticket by its unique identifier.

---

## Request Details

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Method   | `GET` |
| URL      | `{{baseUrl}}/tickets/:id` |

---

## Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type   | Required | Description                        | Example                    |
|-----------|--------|----------|------------------------------------|----------------------------|
| `id`      | string | Yes      | The unique ID of the ticket to retrieve. | `6a727f8b613a3e858239fa27` |

---

## Notes

- `{{baseUrl}}` must be defined in your active environment.
- Returns a `404` if no ticket with the given `id` exists.

## Create One Ticket

Creates a single new support ticket.

---

## Request Details

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Method   | `POST` |
| URL      | `{{baseUrl}}/tickets` |

---

## Headers

| Key            | Value              | Required |
|----------------|--------------------|----------|
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` | Yes      |

---

## Authentication

Requires a Bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer {{vault:token}}
```

---

## Request Body

| Field         | Type   | Required | Description                                      | Example                                              |
|---------------|--------|----------|--------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `title`       | string | Yes      | Short title summarizing the issue.               | `"Problème de connexion VPN"`                        |
| `description` | string | Yes      | Detailed description of the issue.               | `"Impossible de me connecter au réseau distant..."` |
| `status`      | string | Yes      | Initial status of the ticket.                    | `"Open"`                                             |
| `priority`    | string | Yes      | Priority level of the ticket (numeric as string).| `"3"`                                                |

**Example:**
```json
{
    "title": "Problème de connexion VPN",
    "description": "Impossible de me connecter au réseau distant depuis ce matin.",
    "status": "Open",
    "priority": "3"
}
```

---

## Notes

- `{{baseUrl}}` must be defined in your active environment.
- `{{vault:token}}` is read from the Postman Vault.

## Create Many Tickets

Creates multiple support tickets in a single request by sending an array of ticket objects.

---

## Request Details

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Method   | `POST` |
| URL      | `{{baseUrl}}/tickets` |

---

## Headers

| Key            | Value              | Required |
|----------------|--------------------|----------|
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` | Yes      |

---

## Authentication

Requires a Bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer {{vault:token}}
```

---

## Request Body

Send a JSON **array** of ticket objects. Each object supports the following fields:

| Field         | Type   | Required | Description                                       | Example                                              |
|---------------|--------|----------|---------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `title`       | string | Yes      | Short title summarizing the issue.                | `"Problème de connexion VP"`                         |
| `description` | string | Yes      | Detailed description of the issue.                | `"Impossible de me connecter au réseau distant..."` |
| `status`      | string | Yes      | Initial status of the ticket.                     | `"Open"`                                             |
| `priority`    | string | Yes      | Priority level of the ticket (numeric as string). | `"3"`                                                |

**Example:**
```json
[
    {
        "title": "Problème de connexion VP",
        "description": "Impossible de me connecter au réseau distant depuis ce matin.",
        "status": "Open",
        "priority": "3"
    }
]
```

---

## Notes

- `{{baseUrl}}` must be defined in your active environment.
- `{{vault:token}}` is read from the Postman Vault.

## Update One Ticket

Partially updates a single ticket identified by its unique ID. Only the fields provided in the request body will be updated.

---

## Request Details

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Method   | `PATCH` |
| URL      | `{{baseUrl}}/tickets/:id` |

---

## Headers

| Key            | Value              | Required |
|----------------|--------------------|----------|
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` | Yes      |

---

## Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type   | Required | Description                         | Example                    |
|-----------|--------|----------|-------------------------------------|----------------------------|
| `id`      | string | Yes      | The unique ID of the ticket to update. | `6a727f8b613a3e858239fa27` |

---

## Request Body

Provide only the fields you want to update:

| Field      | Type   | Required | Description                        | Example    |
|------------|--------|----------|------------------------------------|------------|
| `status`   | string | No       | New status for the ticket.         | `"Open"`   |
| `priority` | string | No       | New priority level for the ticket. | `"2"`      |
| `title`    | string | No       | Updated title for the ticket.      | `"New title"` |

**Example:**
```json
{
  "status": "Open"
}
```

---

## Notes

- `{{baseUrl}}` must be defined in your active environment.
- Returns a `404` if no ticket with the given `id` exists.

## Update Many Tickets

Partially updates multiple tickets in a single request. Provide a list of ticket IDs and the fields to update — all matched tickets will receive the same changes.

---

## Request Details

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Method   | `PATCH` |
| URL      | `{{baseUrl}}/tickets` |

---

## Headers

| Key            | Value              | Required |
|----------------|--------------------|----------|
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` | Yes      |

---

## Request Body

| Field        | Type     | Required | Description                                          | Example |
|--------------|----------|----------|------------------------------------------------------|---------|
| `ids`        | string[] | Yes      | Array of ticket IDs to update.                       | `["6a727f8b613a3e858239fa27"]` |
| `updateData` | object   | Yes      | Object containing the fields and values to apply to all matched tickets. | `{"priority": 3}` |

**Example:**
```json
{
    "ids": [
        "6a727f8b613a3e858239fa27",
        "6a727f8b613a3e858239fa29"
    ],
    "updateData": {
        "priority": 3
    }
}
```

---

## Notes

- `{{baseUrl}}` must be defined in your active environment.
- All tickets in the `ids` array receive the same `updateData` changes.

## Add Note to Ticket

Appends a note to an existing ticket. Notes are typically used by technicians to log progress, actions taken, or resolution details.

---

## Request Details

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Method   | `POST` |
| URL      | `{{baseUrl}}/tickets/:id/notes` |

---

## Headers

| Key            | Value              | Required |
|----------------|--------------------|----------|
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` | Yes      |

---

## Authentication

Requires a Bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer {{vault:token}}
```

---

## Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type   | Required | Description                              | Example                    |
|-----------|--------|----------|------------------------------------------|----------------------------|
| `id`      | string | Yes      | The unique ID of the ticket to add a note to. | `6a727f8b613a3e858239fa27` |

---

## Request Body

| Field         | Type   | Required | Description                                      | Example                      |
|---------------|--------|----------|--------------------------------------------------|------------------------------|
| `text`        | string | Yes      | The content of the note.                         | `"Réparé"`                   |
| `technician`  | string | Yes      | The ID of the technician adding the note.        | `"6a727f8a613a3e858239fa22"` |

**Example:**
```json
{
    "text": "Réparé",
    "technician": "6a727f8a613a3e858239fa22"
}
```

---

## Notes

- `{{baseUrl}}` must be defined in your active environment.
- `{{vault:token}}` is read from the Postman Vault.

## Delete One Ticket

Permanently deletes a single ticket identified by its unique ID.

---

## Request Details

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Method   | `DELETE` |
| URL      | `{{baseUrl}}/tickets/:id` |

---

## Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type   | Required | Description                          | Example                    |
|-----------|--------|----------|--------------------------------------|----------------------------|
| `id`      | string | Yes      | The unique ID of the ticket to delete. | `6a727f8b613a3e858239fa27` |

---

## Notes

- `{{baseUrl}}` must be defined in your active environment.
- This action is irreversible. The ticket cannot be recovered after deletion.
- Returns a `404` if no ticket with the given `id` exists.

## Delete Many Tickets

Permanently deletes multiple tickets in a single request by providing an array of ticket IDs.

---

## Request Details

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Method   | `DELETE` |
| URL      | `{{baseUrl}}/tickets` |

---

## Request Body

| Field  | Type     | Required | Description                          | Example |
|--------|----------|----------|--------------------------------------|---------|
| `ids`  | string[] | Yes      | Array of ticket IDs to delete.       | `["6a727f8b613a3e858239fa27"]` |

**Example:**
```json
{
    "ids": [
        "6a727f8b613a3e858239fa27",
        "6a727f8b613a3e858239fa29"
    ]
}
```

---

## Notes

- `{{baseUrl}}` must be defined in your active environment.
- This action is irreversible. Deleted tickets cannot be recovered.
- All tickets in the `ids` array will be permanently removed.

item.name: Connections

request.description:
## Login

Authenticates a user and initiates a session. Send valid credentials to receive an authentication token that can be used to access protected endpoints.

---

## Request Details

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Method   | `POST` |
| URL      | `{{baseUrl}}/auth/login` |

---

## Headers

| Key            | Value              | Required |
|----------------|--------------------|----------|
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` | Yes      |

---

## Request Body

Send a JSON object with the following fields:

| Field      | Type   | Required | Description                          | Example                            |
|------------|--------|----------|--------------------------------------|-------------------------------------|
| `email`    | string | Yes      | The registered email of the user.    | `alice.dupont@ticketflow.com`      |
| `password` | string | Yes      | The account password for the user.   | `password123`                      |

**Example:**
```json
{
  "email": "alice.dupont@ticketflow.com",
  "password": "password123"
}
```

---

## Response

On success, the server returns an authentication token. Store this token in your environment (e.g., as `{{token}}`) and include it as a `Bearer` token in the `Authorization` header for all subsequent requests that require authentication:

```
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
```

---

## Notes

- `{{baseUrl}}` must be defined in your active environment. It represents the base URL of the TicketFlow API (e.g., `https://api.ticketflow.com`).
- Credentials are transmitted in the request body — always use HTTPS in production environments.

## Logout

Terminates the current authenticated session. Call this endpoint to invalidate the user's session token and log out securely.

---

## Request Details

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Method   | `POST` |
| URL      | `{{baseUrl}}/auth/logout` |

---

## Authentication

This endpoint requires a valid session. Include the authentication token in the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
```

---

## Request Body

No request body is required.

---

## Notes

- After a successful logout, the token is invalidated and can no longer be used to access protected endpoints.
- `{{baseUrl}}` must be defined in your active environment.

item.description: Handles authentication lifecycle for the TicketFlow API. Contains the **Login** and **Logout** endpoints (`POST /auth/login` and `POST /auth/logout`), which manage session establishment and termination. These requests should be run at the start and end of any authenticated workflow.
